codeFindings.desc: SQL Injection in dynamic ClickHouse WHERE clause constructed from user dashboard query.
Static Vault root token fallback hardcoded in cluster bootstrap configuration.
API key validation check accepts expired keys when Redis cache connection drops.
SSRF in custom alert webhook integration allows querying Kubernetes API server.
Customer environment variables and authorization headers logged in raw payload dumps.
XSS in custom dashboard widget iframe allows script execution in tenant context.
CSRF on team invite member removal endpoint.
ClickHouse query syntax and partition errors returned in client HTTP 400 responses.
God class: OrganizationAccount contains 78 fields and 42 helper methods.
Cache stampede under high concurrent dashboard loading.
Magic numbers for buffer allocation sizes and timeout thresholds.
Sequential Stripe invoice item creation inside tenant iteration loop.
PBKDF2 iteration count configured to 50,000; recommended is 600,000.
Internal gRPC connection between ingest and query service lacks TLS enforcement.
Dead code: Deprecated v1 PagerDuty events API connector.
Hardcoded template styling properties duplicated across 4 report formats.
Uncompressed intermediate memory buffer during 5GB Parquet chunk generation.
Rate limit token count decrement race condition under parallel burst traffic.
Open redirect on post-SAML relay state return parameter.
Repeated regex compilation inside high-frequency query parsing loop.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in ClickHouse Custom Query
vulnerabilities.desc: Unsanitized user-defined metric calculation creates SQL injection into analytical cluster.

vulnerabilities.title: Static Vault Root Token Committed in Source
vulnerabilities.desc: Static development root token fallback present in production initialization script.

vulnerabilities.title: API Key Authorization Bypass on Cache Drop
vulnerabilities.desc: Redis connection timeout causes API key check to fail-open, permitting unauthenticated calls.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Request Forgery via Alert Webhooks
vulnerabilities.desc: Alert notification webhook allows targeting 169.254.169.254 AWS metadata and internal endpoints.

vulnerabilities.title: Customer Auth Tokens Logged in Cleartext
vulnerabilities.desc: Customer authorization bearer tokens dumped into diagnostic tracing logs.

vulnerabilities.title: Rate Limit Bypass via Concurrent Request Burst
vulnerabilities.desc: Token bucket race condition allows malicious tenants to bypass API quota limits.

vulnerabilities.title: Cross-Site Scripting in Custom Widget Iframe
vulnerabilities.desc: Tenant dashboard widget allows script injection compromising session cookies.

vulnerabilities.title: CSRF in Team Member Removal Action
vulnerabilities.desc: Organization team member removal lacks anti-CSRF token verification.

vulnerabilities.title: Open Redirect in SAML SSO RelayState
vulnerabilities.desc: RelayState parameter is not checked against approved organization domains.

vulnerabilities.title: ClickHouse Error Schema Exposure
vulnerabilities.desc: Detailed analytical schema column names leaked in client JSON error outputs.
